{{Quote|Hope you've got an appetite for Killiks, because that's what's on the menu&mdash;probably ten of them for every one of us.|Ross|<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />}}
'''Ross''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] stationed in [[King's Pass|the Pass]]. Ross and her forces were under attack from Killik raiders and [[House Ulgo]] soldiers, and were in need of immediate assistance. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] commanded the Republic combatant to go to King's Pass and relieve the fighters there while he worked with [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa's]] leaders to refine their strategies. The combatant was ultimately successful, and their efforts overwhelmed House Organa's enemies and forced them to retreat from King's Pass.

==Behind the scenes==
Ross is voiced by [[Courtenay Taylor]]. Male Republic characters are able to flirt with Ross.
